items.title: fix(agents): keep tool catalogs stable across completion wake turns (…
items.summary: fix(agents): keep tool catalogs stable across completion wake turns (#182191) * fix(agents): retain session client capabilities across wake turns Record operator client capabilities in session metadata and reuse that fact for tool definitions and the Code Mode catalog across wakes and recovery. Keep current-client execution gates and live browser recipient checks, with actionable guidance when a wake cannot invoke a client-bound tool. Document declaration replacement and reset lifecycle. Add regressions for stable WebChat catalogs and refused unbound screen calls. * fix(agents): keep session creation catalogs stable across wakes Keep sessions_create in the offered tool surface when a WebChat operator turn becomes a senderless wake or recovery turn. Gate unauthorized execution with the existing tool refusal helper and retain live creation-owner checks. This prevents the deferred Code Mode catalog count from changing with the current turn's session-write authority, including CLI chat.send sessions. Extend the prefix-stability regression for browser and CLI clients carrying real admitted operator authority, and verify that a denied constructor cannot gain authority from a later caller context. Keep the existing session-owned client capability and screen enforcement fix. Validation: the new operator/wake cases fail on 34f94e4a0db with exactly sessions_create missing. Focused prefix and session-create suites pass. * fix(agents): gate completion tool denies without changing catalogs Use the requester session ceiling for plugin listing and keep the child-completion policy in execution and descendant authority. Preserve a subagent requester own inherited restrictions and give denied completion calls an explicit refusal. Prove stable plugin definitions and Code Mode catalog, denied execution, and nested requester listing. The exact regression fails on ca48d438c1b and passes with this change; focused policy/plugin suites, repeated touched tests, lint, agent typecheck, and independent review pass. * test(agents): assert creation authority at execution Update existing session-creation integration assertions for the stable catalog contract. Require unauthorized calls to return the execution gate refusal, never dispatch to the creation handler, and preserve the session key set. Keep explicit policy-deny coverage. * test(agents): allow concurrent swarm startup calls Assert the exact schema-bearing worker set while retaining all collector completion-order checks. Initial calls below maxConcurrent may race; only overflow children queue FIFO. * test(agents): use explicit swarm call comparator Satisfy typed sort-comparator lint while preserving the exact schema-bearing worker set and all completion-order assertions.
